description: A taint of a node that the valkey pods tolerate.

key.description: Key of the taint the toleration matches. Matches all keys with `Exists` when unset.

operator.description: How the value of the taint is compared. Defaults to `Equal` in Kubernetes.

value.description: Value of the taint the toleration matches, with `Equal`, `Lt` and `Gt`.

effect.description: Effect of the taint the toleration matches. Matches all effects when unset.

tolerationSeconds.description: Seconds the pod stays on a node with a matching `NoExecute` taint.
